decisions.diagnosis: Commissioning period: counter 229 registered almost nothing (0-9 bikes a day, one day of 101) until it started counting properly on 2014-10-10 07:00; the riders who passed were not recorded and cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: Daily totals 2014-08-16..2014-10-09 are 0-9 except 2014-10-06 (101), then 149, 306, 380, 231 from 2014-10-10; zeros(counter=True) shows daytime zero runs throughout Aug-Sep 2014.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 229 reported flat zeros in both directions for ten days while it had been counting ~400 bikes a day, then resumed at the same level: a counter outage whose counts cannot be recovered.
Intermittent outage of counter 229: flat zeros in both directions between days of normal counts; not recoverable.

Counter 229 outage: seven months of flat zeros in both directions, 'good' status, ending with counts resuming at the prior level; other City of Sydney piezo counters show similar long dead spells, so these zeros are a fault, not a closure, and cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: Zero run 5246 h (usual ~53,000 bikes); 2016-04-30 counts start 12:45 (205), May 2016 424/day vs Aug 2015 372/day.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 229 outage: ten months of flat zeros in both directions after a normal day, then counts resume at the prior level; not recoverable.
decisions.evidence: 2017-07-27 449 bikes, 2017-07-28..2018-05-31 all 0, 2018-06-01 counting from ~09:15; zero run 7402 h, usual ~74,700 bikes; neighbours 103/258/544 kept counting normally.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 229 outage: ten months of flat zeros after a normal weekend, then counts resume at the prior level; not recoverable.
Counter 229 outage: 11 weeks of flat zeros in both directions between days of ~500 bikes; when it resumed it reported two channels per slot, consistent with a repair/reconfiguration; not recoverable.
Counter 229 failed for good: a year of flat zeros in both directions (some days flagged 'warning') until its record ends; the counts cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: 2021-12-24 416 bikes, 2021-12-25..2022-12-14 all 0 (8520 h, usual ~86,000 bikes); 768 'warning' records in Dec 2021; neighbours 544/258/551 counting normally in 2022.

series.name: Northbound / outbound (counter 229, 2014-2022)
series.evidence: Only counter-direction of the Ecocounter unit for this flow; kept separate from counter 370 because there is no overlap (a ~3-year gap) and no neighbour with a single continuous counter across 2021-2025 to show the two units read comparably.

series.name: Southbound / citybound (counter 229, 2014-2022)
series.evidence: Only counter-direction of the Ecocounter unit for this flow; kept separate from 370/1778 for the same reason (no overlap, different vendor, cannot confirm comparable readings).

series.name: Westbound / outbound (counter 370, 2025-)
series.evidence: Metrocount replacement; its hourly profile (PM peak 30/h at 17:00) matches 330 (PM peak 34/h), so it carries the same flow as 330, but it is kept as its own series because comparability across the 2022-2025 gap cannot be checked.

series.name: Eastbound / citybound (counter 370, 2025-)
series.evidence: Metrocount replacement; AM peak 34/h at 08:00 matches 331 (41/h at 08:00) and both are flagged citybound, so it is the same flow as 331, but kept separate for lack of any overlap to verify level.

useful: zeros(counter=True): gave the exact slot boundaries of every outage of counter 229
daily(wide=True): confirmed each outage edge and the commissioning period at a glance
channels: showed the 2020-11 switch to two records per slot is two distinct channels (e.g. [8,0],[0,5],[3,14]), not duplicates
hourly: matched 330<->1777 and 331<->1778 by AM/PM commute peaks
monthly on neighbours: showed other City of Sydney counters with the same kind of long dead spells while nearby counters kept counting
directions: ruled out mirroring on counter 370 despite the West/East ratio drifting 1.2 -> 1.0 -> 1.1
not_useful: duplicates: flagged 2020-11-16..30 only because the month mixes 1- and 2-channel days; the 'matched' slots are coincidental equal values (mostly zeros), so drop_duplicates would be wrong there
spikes: at a path with low median counts every 20-bike slot is flagged; all were ordinary riding
improve: duplicates: compute the usual record count per direction from the neighbouring days rather than the calendar month, so a mid-month channel change is not reported as duplication
overview: a wide view (a column per direction) would be easier to scan than one row per direction-month
spikes: require a higher absolute floor or compare with the same weekday/hour mean rather than the median to cut false positives on quiet paths
add: a tool listing the first and last non-zero slot around each long zero run, with the day totals either side, to set decision edges directly
a cross-gap comparison tool: for a replaced counter, find neighbours with a single counter spanning both periods and report the ratio before and after

summary: Site 560 had an Ecocounter piezo (229, 2014-2022) that was dead for long stretches (Sep 2015-Apr 2016, Jul 2017-Jun 2018, Aug 2018-Jun 2019, Aug-Nov 2020 and from Christmas 2021 to its end) plus a weak commissioning period, all set missing; the counts between outages look sound, including the 2020-11 switch to two channels per slot. The Metrocount replacement (370, from Nov 2025) shows no faults. Directions 330/1777 and 331/1778 carry the same flows by their commute profiles, but with a 3-year gap and a different vendor they are kept as four separate series.
